opening.argument: The speaker presents PlusToken as a crypto app where viewers put cryptocurrency into an AI Dog feature in exchange for approximately ten percent monthly earnings. He characterizes the mechanism as an arbitrage trading bot, calls it a passive opportunity, and directs viewers to register through the website or app. The offer also links participation to multilevel recruitment, promising bonuses or commissions across ten levels and matching bonuses on personal referrals. A due-diligence disclaimer appears alongside these promotional instructions and return-linked participation claims, but it does not change the substance of the opportunity being promoted.
